ranked.headline: Computational methods couple spatial context and regulatory structure in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add spatially resolved models for cell communication, localized gene markers, and chromatin loops at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Evidence-grounded LLM agents automating single-cell, spatial, and molecular analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple LLM agents with DE genes, provenance graphs, and bioinformatics skill graphs to replace parametric recall with explicit evidence.

ranked.headline: Long-read accuracy saturates at 20-45x; somatic callers diverge on tumour-only data
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and new callers test how platform, coverage and tumour-only context constrain variant calls and their interpretation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether DNA and protein models capture biological structure
ranked.summary: Raw-sequence LLM benchmarks and new distributional metrics now test what biological models learn, not only what they generate.

ranked.headline: Representation learning for incomplete, confounded single-cell and spatial measurements
ranked.summary: Generative, contrastive, and diffusion-based models are being built to impute, disentangle, and translate across incomplete omics and imaging data.

ranked.headline: Raw-read and benchmarked pipelines advance microbial genomics analysis methods
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark and extend pipelines for metagenomes, amplicons, and raw reads across bacteria, fungi, and viruses.

ranked.headline: Genomic ML models tested for transfer, shift robustness and mechanistic interpretability
ranked.summary: Recent genomic ML preprints assess cross-cohort generalisation, distribution shift and mechanistic probes as outcomes beyond aggregate accuracy.

ranked.headline: Automated tools for cell segmentation and QC in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Pretrained segmentation and adaptive filtering tools now target whole-cell boundaries and ambient RNA artifacts in spatial and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Parameter inference and calibration of mechanistic models of biological systems
ranked.summary: LLM-driven workflows now reconstruct and calibrate mechanistic models, alongside new inference tools for stochastic and agent-based systems.

ranked.headline: LLMs and curated graphs turn biomedical literature into queryable evidence resources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLM text mining and evidence integration to build queryable knowledge bases for toxicity, drug discovery, and genetics.

ranked.headline: Portable, inspectable software tools for omics analysis, visualization and modelling
ranked.summary: Recent tools package omics and genomics analyses as serverless web apps, Nextflow pipelines and standardized Bioconductor data objects.

ranked.headline: Population genomic methods recover hidden variation and context-dependent selection
ranked.summary: Reference-independent assembly and new population statistics are expanding what current variant and selection analyses can detect in human genomes.

ranked.headline: Graph attention and graph transformers model drug, protein and glycan interactions
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph attention and transformer encoders with protein-side structure and pretraining for molecular prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models predict protein interactions, protease cleavage and binding shifts
ranked.summary: Recent work extends structure-aware graph learning to protease specificity at scale and to mutation-induced binding affinity changes.

ranked.headline: Coupling and modulation parameters shape oscillatory states across network models
ranked.summary: Mapping oscillatory regimes against synaptic, conduction, and modulatory parameters now gives testable coupling-level accounts across network scales.

ranked.headline: Transformer and graph models learn regulatory links from DNA, RNA and protein sequences
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence models and graph architectures are now being applied to chromatin state, gene regulatory network and lncRNA interaction prediction across…

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics traces gene duplication and innovation across distant lineages
ranked.summary: High-quality genome assemblies and new synteny and phylogenetic tools now allow direct comparison of gene content across distant prokaryotic and eukaryotic…

ranked.headline: Spatial and temporal structure set ecological network robustness and disease dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat spatial and temporal coupling as a first-order control on species ranges, network collapse, and arboviral spread.

ranked.headline: Throughput tools for MD trajectories, ML force fields, and protein flexibility
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers target throughput bottlenecks in trajectory storage, force field construction, and flexibility estimation from structure.

ranked.headline: Supervised models on biological features predict drug toxicity and resistance
ranked.summary: Reduced or constructed feature representations are now evaluated as part of prediction performance across kinase, KRAS, enzyme, and expression datasets.

ranked.headline: New tools target reproducible environments, DNA library design, and SBML model encoding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow builder address dependency resolution, oligo pool design, and SBML Level 3 model authoring.

ranked.headline: Conditional models and benchmarks probe structure-aware molecular prediction and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test when target context, cofolding accuracy, and activity-cliff models actually improve molecular prediction and design.

ranked.headline: Learned and coarse-grained energetic models extended beyond original parameterization
ranked.summary: Transfer tests now span polypeptoid coarse-graining, non-canonical cyclic peptide structure prediction, and femtosecond-to-nanosecond time-step bridging.

ranked.headline: Computation sets receptor and kinase conformational states and experimental constructs
ranked.summary: Computational methods now set the experimental object itself, from GPCR construct screening for cryo-EM to MD-resolved receptor and kinase states.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and matrix-factorization methods link GWAS loci to causal genes and tissues
ranked.summary: Correlated phenotypes and pleiotropy in GWAS and TWAS data make causal gene attribution harder, motivating methods that model these structures explicitly.

ranked.headline: Residue distance descriptors probe protein dynamics and human-virus interface evolution
ranked.summary: Residue-level distance and contact descriptors now link ubiquitin-like domain dynamics, mimic-targeted viral interfaces, and salt bridge design.

ranked.headline: Structure, composition and gene order used to infer prokaryotic gene function
ranked.summary: Structure-based and k-mer methods now assign function and genetic codes across archaeal and bacterial genomes without direct homology.

ranked.headline: LPS-phospholipid separation in outer membrane models shapes peptide and polymer binding
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained simulations now resolve how LPS-phospholipid separation governs peptide and polymer partitioning in outer membranes.

ranked.headline: Genomic context and 3D contacts link regulatory elements to expression output
ranked.summary: Yeast position-based expression models and a Brassica napus regulatory network both treat noncoding elements as context-dependent units.

ranked.headline: Reference-free scoring and computational speedups for protein and RNA 3D structures
ranked.summary: Predicted and simulated conformational ensembles need scoring and analysis tools that avoid reference structures or pairwise distance matrices.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic and single-cell representations link brain cell types to disease
ranked.summary: Multi-omic integration of up to 1,358 aged brain samples and reviewed foundation-model routes link molecular features to cell types and disease.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide sequencing and ancient DNA resolve population structure and admixture history
ranked.summary: Large sequence and ancient genome resources now allow bias-corrected admixture and temporal polygenic analyses across populations.

ranked.headline: Attractor and memory dynamics define disease states in rheumatic and cancer models
ranked.summary: Disease states are increasingly modeled as attractors, order parameters, and history-dependent dynamics rather than static marker lists.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and transformer generators coupled to MD and QM data for molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 papers couple learned generators and predictors to MD and quantum-mechanical data for flexible-pocket and multi-target molecular design.
